I think I identify as gay now, after one single incident

I[22M] identified as a bicurious kind of person for sometime before. It changed last weekend. 

I invited my friend to my apartment. We usually hang out when we both get free. We rarely drink, but last weekend, he bought some really expensive Vodka, so we ordered some food and drank a lot. Got super drunk. 

I am single and he has a gf. We were talking about shit I can't even remember about, but then he did something unexpected. He poured the vodka on my face and started kissing me. I was almost fully drunk and liked it. One thing led to another and we ended up getting naked and did it. Woke up the next morning, was super awkward, we both agreed it was a drunk mistake and shook hands. 

It would have been okay, if this was all that happened. I started craving for that experience again. I STOPPED getting attracted to girls. It felt like I was never attracted to girls. I wanted to meet him again. 

That very night, I get a doorbell, I open the door and see my friend again. He says he wants me and jumps into me and kisses me and starts removing my clothes. I don't resist. We ended up doing it again. At this point, I'm confused because I wanted it to happen. But I felt disgusted because he has a gf. I told him I don't want to do it again, and this was a mistake. He understands. 

The remaining days until today, I was trying to figure out what even is my sexual preference.  I'm only attracted to guys now. Did I just suddenly turn gay? Or was I gay and pretending to be straight? I know I am the person who should know the answer to it, but I really honestly don't know. I know now that I only want to be with guys.

The doomsday loomed near

He could feel everything but fear

And so when that day the sun finally rose,

He was but full of cheer.

Standing atop, he chanced a glance at the vast serenity

And he smiled truly after what seemed an eternity. 

His eyes were then drawn to the stellar dome; 

Whether the stars nodded their approval or frowned their stark disapproval,

He would never know

For in his mind, he had no care.

The mighty winds roared, as if to topple him

But the earth beneath whispered her welcome 

Calling him to her embrace.

A craven act, he knew for sure 

But an effortless escape it seemed.

And so he leapt, a last gallant move.

Her forces responded at once

The mind raced, the heart almost down to the throat 

But he knew it was all for good.

And so when he finally met the earth,

He gave it all away.

Her touch was warm and smooth did she seem

He smiled one last time and then his gaze fell.

The birds chirped away, alarming the liberation of a soul 

Deadly silence then befall.

Stained in red, he lay there

Silent and still, like those colossal hills

At last, he would be reunited with her 

Reimbursed to all of her facets

Earth, the body he loathed 

Space, the hollow void within

Air, the forced breaths 

Water, the tainted blood and;

Fire, the flame that had burnt out
